body:
PR #1827 (TASK-1231): operator agreed to hand you the execution_mode fence — it's your acceptance criterion, you caught both misses, and merge is yours. Operator confirmed KEEP UNSET for selection.

Your recipe stands: (1) emit execution_mode in list --format json (absent today; --fields mode is ignored for json — BUG-1149 cousin), (2) fence execution_mode ∈ {drive,guided,operator,decide}, keep drain+unset, (3) add a drive-mode-no-tag test.

One wrinkle so we agree on the predicate: merge_requires_supervision(None)=true — it excludes UNSET too. So for SELECTION don't reuse it verbatim (that'd drop unset). Selection = exclude only the 4 supervised modes, keep None+Drain. The merge gate correctly still excludes unset (unset drains → stops at the supervised-merge gate → you merge). Full detail on TASK-1231's comment.

Base: branch task-1231-autoprogress has the command built + tested; the tag-net is fine as defense-in-depth. Impl options: emit execution_mode in the list-json serde struct + parse it, OR pivot ready_specs to in-process store load (.aida-store CachedGitBackend + leased_spec_ids) reading r.execution_mode directly. Your call. Thanks for the two catches.
